metadata.title: Oriented V-systems
metadata.abstract: We introduce the notion of an oriented $\vee$-system which gives a class of solutions of the oriented associativity equations generalising Veselov's $\vee$-system solutions of WDVV equations. An oriented $\vee$-system is a special configuration of pairs of a vector and a covector in a linear space. We show that the class of oriented $\vee$-systems is closed under taking subsystems and restrictions. We provide examples which include a multiparameter family related to imprimitive complex reflection groups.

analysis.progressType: oriented V-system与定向结合律方程
analysis.workSummary: 作者引入由向量—余向量对组成的oriented V-system，给出定向associativity方程的一类解，推广Veselov的WDVV V-system。该类对取子系统及限制封闭，并给与imprimitive复反射群有关的多参数族。
analysis.breakthrough: 为推广WDVV可积方程提供稳定的配置构造和新解族。
analysis.limitations: 得到特定构造族及封闭性，摘要未声称全部方程解的分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 可积结构基础工具为主。
